description: This script manages the review lifecycle of components by manipulating metadata.yaml files, setting or clearing review dates, and generating reports. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles, as well as displaying help information.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components with metadata.yaml files, excluding documentation and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message detailing usage and actions of the script.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Constructs the path to a component's metadata.yaml and verifies its existence.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets lifecycle date fields in metadata.yaml to a placeholder value.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG report by invoking an external script.
